recognize_zh: 高倍抹片中一顆只比紅血球稍大的細胞，細胞質豐富且布滿紫紅色細顆粒、邊緣帶藍色，只有一個小而緻密的圓形偏位核，符合微小巨核細胞（micromegakaryocyte），是MDS的巨核細胞發育異常線索。
features: Small cell only slightly larger than adjacent red cells
Single small, round, dense, eccentric non-lobated nucleus
Abundant cytoplasm filled with fine pink-purple granules (platelet-type granularity) with a bluish peripheral rim
Low N:C ratio despite small overall cell size
Adjacent mononuclear cell with round nucleus and pale gray cytoplasm; normocytic red cells in background
describe_en: Smear shows a small megakaryocytic cell, only slightly larger than neighboring red cells, with a single small, round, dense, eccentric nucleus and abundant cytoplasm containing fine pink-purple platelet-type granules with a bluish peripheral rim. These features are consistent with a micromegakaryocyte (dwarf megakaryocyte). An adjacent mononuclear cell with a round nucleus and pale cytoplasm is also present. Micromegakaryocytes are a reliable marker of dysmegakaryopoiesis and in the stated context support myelodysplastic neoplasm; overall cellularity and the extent of multilineage dysplasia must be assessed on the full aspirate and core biopsy, supplemented by CD61 or CD42b immunostaining.

ddx.vs: Mast cells have densely packed dark purple metachromatic granules that often obscure an oval central nucleus and are tryptase and CD117 positive, rather than fine pink platelet-type granules.
Basophils have a segmented nucleus overlaid by coarse, dark blue-black granules, not a single small round nucleus with fine granular cytoplasm.
Megakaryoblasts have a high N:C ratio with fine chromatin, nucleoli and agranular blebbed cytoplasm, while this cell has condensed nuclear chromatin and granular mature cytoplasm.
Plasma cells have deep blue agranular cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof and clock-face chromatin.
